standard_prerequisites.name: Twist sheaves and multiplication maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: chapter definitions of the twists and the multiplication maps (section-level, not carded)
standard_prerequisites.use: O_X(nd) and M(nd)-tilde are the tildes of the shifted graded modules, and the three multiplication maps are induced by the shift identifications.

core_obligations: The graded module maps S to S(nd) and M to M(nd), x mapsto f^n x, become isomorphisms after inverting f.
The first gives S_(f) = S(nd)_(f), hence O_{D_+(f)} = O_X(nd)|_{D_+(f)}: the twists are trivial on the standard open.

The second gives S(nd)_(f) tensor_{S_(f)} M_(f) = M(nd)_(f), the isomorphism for the map of equation-multiply-more-generally; the map of equation-multiply-on-sheaf is a consequence of the map of equation-multiply.
proof_roadmap: Write the shift maps, invert f, read off the two localization isomorphisms, and deduce the remaining multiplication maps.
difficulty_reason: Localization isomorphism S_(f) = S(nd)_(f) from multiplication by f^n, the module case by the same shift maps, the remaining multiplication maps as consequences; fully displayed.
